title: MANE: A Multi-Path Adaptive Network for Edge Onloading of Deep Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.14660v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Split computing constitutes a widely used distributed inference approach, where a lightweight head model is onloaded onto the device and a heavier tail model resides on an edge server, leveraging the growing computational capabilities of modern System-on-Chips while alleviating server load. As intelligent indoor environments such as smart offices grow increasingly populated with diverse IoT devices, a single edge server must simultaneously assist multiple devices, each competing for the same shared inference resources. Without a principled mechanism to manage this shared load, the server is quickly overwhelmed, causing latency SLO violations and rendering server-assisted inference ineffective. In this work, we present MANE, a distributed inference framework that equips the server with a multi-path tail architecture, enabling a dynamic accuracy--throughput trade-off at runtime. translated_title: MANE：一种用于深度神经网络边缘卸载的多路径自适应网络
translated_abstract: 分割计算是一种广泛使用的分布式推理方法，其中轻量级的头部模型被卸载到设备上，而较重的尾部模型驻留在边缘服务器上，这种方法既利用了现代片上系统日益增长的计算能力，又减轻了服务器的负载。随着智能办公等智能室内环境中的物联网设备日益增多，单个边缘服务器必须同时辅助多个设备，而每个设备都在争夺相同的共享推理资源。如果没有一个合理的机制来管理这种共享负载，服务器很快就会不堪重负，导致延迟SLO（服务水平目标）违规，使服务器辅助推理失效。在这项工作中，我们提出了MANE，一个分布式推理框架，它为服务器配备了多路径尾部架构，能够在运行时实现动态的精度-吞吐量权衡。通过引入一种新颖的多路径模型架构……
tldr: MANE是一种分布式推理框架，通过为边缘服务器配备多路径尾部架构，在运行时实现动态的精度-吞吐量权衡，从而有效管理多设备共享推理资源时的服务器负载。
en_tdlr: MANE is a distributed inference framework that equips edge servers with a multi-path tail architecture, enabling dynamic accuracy-throughput trade-offs at runtime to effectively manage server load when multiple devices share inference resources.
